fetch.note: News Break does not publish how often it fetches. News Distribution serves no feed for it yet.

focus.local.note: News Break focuses on local news, so local categories are the usual choice. Read on a third-party guide (RebelMouse). Publishers apply on News Break's publisher page (Apply to be a Partner).

rules.category_not_included.note: When a list of categories to include is set, an article has to be in one of them.

rules.category_excluded.note: An article in an excluded category is left out of this channel.

rules.tag_excluded.note: An article with an excluded tag is left out of this channel.

rules.author_not_listed.note: When authors are limited, an article by someone else is left out of this channel.

rules.post_type_off.note: An article of a post type that is not ticked is left out of this channel.

rules.language_off.note: An article in a language that is not ticked is left out of this channel.

rules.image_missing.note: When a featured image is required, an article without one is left out of this channel. News Break's own image rule could not be confirmed, so this is the owner's choice.

rules.not_local.note: An article that an add-on has classified as not local is left out of this channel. Nothing sets it unless an add-on does.

channel.manual.note: News Distribution serves no feed for News Break yet and cannot see News Break's answer to an application. The rules decide what would go into a feed.
